==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in a space with oversized colorful blocks, giant playing cards, and clear rectangular bins of random wooden shapes. A couple of students I know have been tasked with trying to arrange the items in these bins to produce a magical effect. I was not selected to do this, because the teacher doesn't believe I have the skill to do so.

My witchy instructor thinks so little of me. I am not entirely sure why. The task the other students are struggling with seems so simple to me.

I tell one of the students that they need to eat to boost the effectiveness of the spell and use the arrangement of life, universe, water. This block combination summons a giant turtle that splashes into the cosmos itself. The Earth is flooded by my act of rebellion.
